verdict.rationale: Supabase has an official, documented MCP server that is live and auth-gated in production (mcp.supabase.com/mcp returns 401 without credentials), confirming real hands-on functionality for connecting AI agents. However community evidence reveals significant caveats: prompt-injection vulnerabilities requiring mitigations, and the MCP/Cursor integration using service_role that bypasses RLS, raising trust concerns for sensitive data.
